extractedItems.title: Ball Bounces Out Of The Hole – Is It Holed?
extractedItems.question: Your ball drops into the hole but bounces out again. What must you do next?

choices.text: Count it as holed and move on
Hole the ball again by playing it as it lies
Add a penalty stroke and pick up your ball
Place the ball back in the hole

extractedItems.explanation: A ball is only holed if it comes to rest in the hole. If it bounces out, you must hole it again by playing it as it lies.
